residualsForTheSeat.what_was_measured_instead: the MCP's failure to project the ring is NOT a missing location. On the artifact of record 48453:367134's MCP snapshot carries queryPoint {longitude:-97.75715, latitude:30.41603} AND the draw frame carries anchor {lat:30.41603, lng:-97.75715}, so tryComposeEnvelopeModelForDraw ran its point-seeded derivation and returned null somewhere after step 1 -- candidates in order: firstParcelRing at that point, the partner-identity guard, resolveAuthoritativeSetbacks (which would be the P-340 resolver gap seen from the MCP side), labelEdges, or wireStatus !== 'ok'. Naming which one is a live/instrumented question, not a reading question.
residualsForTheSeat.the_vocabulary_question_is_already_answe: no new token and no vocabulary copy is needed, and the dispatch's 'never add a vocabulary copy' is therefore not a blocker. @empressaio/atom-contract/display's own VOCABULARY row for atom_path_pending says it means 'Setbacks and the buildable envelope have not been ruled or baked for this jurisdiction yet; no distance or polygon exists to report' -- which is precisely what the payload falsifies. The package already carries the honest token for the case where a resolved district+table draws the polygon: modelled-figure-withheld, defined as a present-state overlay's `basis`. So the repair is to make the overlay's state/reason follow the route attempt's own outcome (and to serve the route's own status token when the derivation declines), not to mint anything.

fleetMemory.LESSON: One composed sentence can produce two distinct instrument classes at once. The panel's single string at atom-chain-to-facets.ts:2503 tripped both SAYS-RULES-UNRULED and SAYS-GEOMETRY-WITHHELD on the same four parcels, because it contained one phrase from each list. Fixing either phrase alone would have left the class firing and looked like a failed fix.

Before inventing a token, read the shared vocabulary's own `meaning` field. @empressaio/atom-contract/display's atom_path_pending row states the exact claim the payload falsified ('have not been ruled or baked for this jurisdiction yet'), and its modelled-figure-withheld row is the token the honest case already needs -- so the dispatch's 'never add a vocabulary copy' constraint turned out not to block the repair at all.
